001package com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.ghosts.types;
002
003import com.fs.starfarer.api.Global;
004import com.fs.starfarer.api.campaign.CampaignFleetAPI;
005import com.fs.starfarer.api.campaign.SectorEntityToken;
006import com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.ghosts.BaseSensorGhost;
007import com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.ghosts.GBCircle;
008import com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.ghosts.GBITowardsEntity;
009import com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.ghosts.GBIntercept;
010import com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.ghosts.GBLeadPlayerTo;
011import com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.ghosts.GBStayInPlace;
012import com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.ghosts.GBStormArea;
013import com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.ghosts.SensorGhostManager;
014
015public class StormTricksterGhost extends BaseSensorGhost {
016
017        public StormTricksterGhost(SensorGhostManager manager, SectorEntityToken target) {
018                super(manager, 40);
019                
020                CampaignFleetAPI pf = Global.getSector().getPlayerFleet();
021                
022                float circleRadius = genFloat(300f, 400f);
023                
024                initEntity(genLargeSensorProfile(), genSmallRadius());
025                if (!placeNearPlayer()) {
026                        setCreationFailed();
027                        return;
028                }
029                
030                addBehavior(new GBIntercept(pf, 10f, 40, circleRadius + 500f, true));
031                addBehavior(new GBCircle(pf, genDelay(2f), 40, circleRadius, 1f));
032                addInterrupt(new GBITowardsEntity(genDelay(1.5f), pf, target));
033                addBehavior(new GBLeadPlayerTo(20f, target, genFloat(500f, 600f), 25));
034                addBehavior(new GBStayInPlace(0.4f + manager.getRandom().nextFloat() * 0.3f));
035                addBehavior(new GBStormArea(1000f));
036        }
037        
038}
